ideas.description: Exploit: the cheapest accuracy buffer that still leaves a net time cut. Base: E081 bundle code (drafts/E081_bundle_submission.py = E069 + fused per-epoch augment + build-time prepare warmups). Two changes, both priced near-misses: (a) the 18 px first stage from E080 (whitening 17 -> pools 8/4/2, 2x2 final map, static-kernel F.max_pool2d; offline paired +0.03 pp, so about free); (b) total epochs 6.75 -> 6.875 (343750 samples), with the extra 0.125 epoch added to the 32 px stage. Do not use 7.0: I114 priced +0.25 epoch at +5.1% time, which would wipe out the bundle's -3.7%. Keep the 20/28 px boundaries (75000, 175000) and the whitening-bias freeze (50000) fixed in samples. The block-1 freeze stays at 0.8 of the new total (275000). Lr warmup/decay, the Muon multiplier and the lookahead (t/T)^3 ramp are indexed by samples seen (port the schedule code from E063/I114). The final partial epoch uses the first 0.875 of its permutation. Extend the fused augment's consumed-sample bookkeeping to match. Warm up every new partial shape at 275000 and at the run end in build() with channels_last tensors (E035), and run debug_nan.py. Offline gate, in ONE process on seeds 3-22, paired against E081 at 6.75 epochs run in the same process: launch on seeds 0-2 only if the paired gain is >= +0.08 pp, the 20-seed mean is >= 0.7540, and offline train time is <= -1.2% vs E069's offline 4.637 s. Launch once and do not re-roll. If an explore screen below (logit scale, residual, warmup) passes first, fold that gain in and drop the +0.125 epoch.
ideas.expected: Time 4.55-4.65 s, point ~4.60 s (-1.7% vs E069's 4.678): E081 -0.172 s, 18 px ~-0.025 s, +0.125 epoch ~+0.118 s. True mean ~0.7545 (+0.08 to +0.15 pp over ~0.7534; I114 measured an upward slope of ~0.9 pp/epoch). The seeds-0-2 draw lands in 0.751-0.758, P(>=0.753) ~70-75%. Feasible means the first new tip since E069. If the offline paired gain is < +0.05 pp, the upward knee is too shallow at +0.125 epoch, and no epoch-funded buffer beats ~0.05 pp per 1%.

ideas.description: Explore: logit scale. First check in drafts/ whether the arena port multiplies logits by a fixed constant (airbench-style 1/9) and where it sits relative to label smoothing. If there is no fixed scale, retire H1.13.1 without a run. If there is one, screen two arms in ONE process on seeds 3-22 against E081 rerun in the same process: logit scale 1/6 and 1/12, with LS 0.2, head lr x2 and head wd unchanged. The scale is a Python constant in the head, so each arm recompiles: warm every train/eval graph variant in build() and run debug_nan.py for each arm. Report per-arm 20-seed means, paired diffs and SE. Promote an arm into the stack idea only if its paired gain is >= +0.12 pp and >= 2 SE. No seeds-0-2 run from this idea.
ideas.expected: Time unchanged (+-0.3%). Paired 20-seed delta -0.30 to +0.30 pp per arm, point 0.0 to +0.05 pp. The scale moves softmax sharpness, the effective head lr (~scale^2) and the gradient sent back to features, and head lr was flat between x2 and x3 (E049). A gain >= +0.12 pp at >= 2 SE supports H1.13.1 and gives a free buffer that replaces the +0.125 epoch (worth ~2.5% time). Both arms within +-1 SE: axis flat, close H1.13. A drop >= 0.2 pp on the 1/12 side means the head is already under-sharp.

ideas.description: Explore/check: does the arena's depth-3 ConvGroup keep airbench96's residual (x = conv3(...) + x0 after the first conv/pool)? Inspect the model code in drafts/. If the residual is present, retire H1.1.5 as not applicable, with no run. If it was dropped, restore it in all three blocks exactly as in airbench96 (add the post-pool, post-first-conv activation to the block output before the final activation, with the same BN placement), keeping dirac init and the block-1-frozen graph variants consistent: detach still cuts at block 1's output. Re-warm every resolution and freeze variant and their partial shapes in build() with channels_last tensors, and run debug_nan.py. Screen offline in ONE process on seeds 3-22 paired against E081 rerun in the same process. Promote into the stack only if the paired gain is >= +0.15 pp at >= 2 SE and offline time is <= +1%.
ideas.expected: ~60% chance the residual is present, so no run and the node is retired. If it is absent: time +0.3% to +1% (one add per block, fused into the BN/SiLU kernel), paired accuracy +0.0 to +0.6 pp, point +0.25 pp. A gain that large funds ~3-5% of cuts (e.g. freeze at 0.7, 28 px to 4.0 epochs). It would also invalidate the skip-free reasoning behind E062/H7 (a block-2 freeze no longer cuts all gradient to block 1). A result within +-1 SE refutes H1.1.5.

ideas.description: Systems: full-trial profile of E081, then one bit-identical cut. Gate in drafts/: profile one complete E081 trial (prepare + train) with the torch profiler and cuda-synchronized wall timers. Report GPU and wall time for (b) the straddling split steps at the 50k/75k/175k/270k switches, (c) lookahead syncs (eager foreach lerp over params and BN buffers, ~43 per trial), (d) the end-of-train copy of slow weights and eval prep, and (e) any host syncs (.item(), Python-side sample-count checks) that stall the stream. Also record E078's never-recorded items (b)-(d). Launch condition: the removable total is >= 0.05 s/trial. If so, make the single largest bit-identical cut, e.g. move the lookahead blend into one compiled foreach function warmed in build(), or remove a host sync by precomputing the step plan (graph variant, lr values, sync flags) as a Python list in prepare. Require offline per-seed equality with E081 in the same process. Do not launch alone; fold it into the next stack candidate. If the removable total is < 0.03 s, close the outside-step axis.
ideas.expected: About 50% chance the gate fails (lookahead 43 x ~0.7 ms = ~0.03 s, already small). If it passes: time -0.8% to -1.5%, point -1.1% (~0.05 s/trial), with accuracy math unchanged (any harness launch is still a process-level re-draw around the base's true mean). This adds ~1% headroom to the stack idea, enough to fund a further ~+0.05 epoch of buffer.

ideas.description: Explore: global warmup fraction on the Muon+curriculum base, never varied as a whole. Base: E081. Two arms in ONE process on seeds 3-22, paired against E081 rerun in the same process: (a) warmup 0.23 -> 0.15; (b) warmup 0.23 -> 0.30. Both groups (Muon multiplier and SGD group) change together. The 0.2x start, the 0.07x floor, the linear decay shape, the stage boundaries, the freeze points and the lookahead ramp stay unchanged. The lr values are fill_'ed 0-d tensors / eager param-group values, so nothing recompiles. Note: the 20 px stage ends at 22% of samples, so (b) keeps all of the 28 px stage's first ~8% in warmup and (a) puts peak lr inside the 20 px stage (cf. E043, where low-res past the peak hurt). Promote an arm into the stack only if its paired gain is >= +0.12 pp at >= 2 SE.
ideas.expected: Time unchanged (+-0.3%). Paired delta per arm -0.35 to +0.25 pp; point -0.05 pp for (a) (E012 and E031 suggest early steps are not under-used) and +0.03 pp for (b). A gain >= +0.12 pp at >= 2 SE supports H1.14 and is a free buffer. Both within 1 SE: the schedule axis is flat, so close H1.14 and treat the recipe's hyperparameters as saturated around the flat ~0.05 pp/1% frontier.
